breakdown.reason: The generated specification still repeats the erroneous restriction from the incomplete prompt. Both the problem-statement section and the implemented code explicitly filter competing phases to only those from neutral (charge 0) and positive (charge +1) folders, while the ground truth uses all four charge states [-2, -1, 0, 1] uniformly with no such post-filtering when reporting competing phases.
